description.text: The eleventh set of the EX series, released on 31 October 2005 with 114 cards, 113 numbered and a secret Azumarill, and two theme decks, Breakthrough and Steeplechase. It is set around Holon, a research city whose magnetic powers change Pokémon, and it brought in Delta Species Pokémon of unexpected types, such as a Metal and Fire Tyranitar and a Metal and Lightning Dragonite, with their own card design. Holon's Pokémon can be played as Energy, and Ditto takes on different types. In Japan it came after Legend Maker's set, but in English it came first.
